verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents configurable expiration policies that automatically delete sandboxes after inactivity, a TTL, or other conditions, explicitly to control costs. Sandboxes also scale to zero automatically after about 5 seconds of inactivity, and archiving lets you shut a sandbox down while keeping its filesystem. missing for 10: an explicit statement that compute billing stops during standby or after scale-to-zero (the cost framing covers snapshot storage only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the timeout and expiration behavior.
